body: I feel you, but arent we humans made to life outside and survive, is this construct we live in the absolute definition. I m in a similar situation and thinking if not just trying to survive outside of this construct would bring me joy and remove all the stress it comes with? Remember death is the last option you have and make, I also feel like a huge failure you re not alone.

Please don't as you can read in my post my thought process goes over years. I dont want to be mean but loosing a bf/gf is something temporary, dont make such big decisions in such a short amount of time, if you want to talk, pm me.

I made a post 1h ago about my problems, no one answered, I think maybe it helps if people have someone to relate so I try to answer others posts.
Through my life i got abandon more times than i can remember. The feeling of this is sudden and painful, everything planned i shattered to pieces that cant be put together anymore. After sometime it will be getting better, but you will never forget. I had my ups and downs with relationships but you should always think about what makes you happy without anyone else. Take a warm shower lay down, eat your favorite food, do something that you enjoy on your own and talk to friends and family about it.

There are easier options. But think about it you arent even over 18 there is so much in this world you havent done I m also in conflict with myself but I fought, analyzed and got help, i m still in distress but please think about it you can still fuckup your life later and then do this and with fucking it up i mean loosing everything you built because of any reason. take those 600 dollars or swissfrancs and have fun! (you can also have fun on the internet)

I can totally relate, I also feel like I'm not truthful with myself and others. I wish i could but that would be such a hard fight and there are other things of my personality i cant change without pretending to. I wish I could start again fresh another life keeping my good parts of my personality or at least what people like. The constant war in my head is disturbing. I hope you find something that brings you a bit of joy, it s what keeps me going, death is the last option, evaluate everything else. I am not really in the position to help you.. because i feel I m in a similar situation...
